verdict.rationale: Cooley's own pages state concrete deal volume: 2,100+ VC financings annually, and 166 reported VC financings representing $85.7B in Q2 2026, with a #1 ranking for companies raising venture capital. Seed-stage priced rounds are covered via the Series Seed equity financing package. Late-stage work is only implied, by representing 30% of US unicorns and being the #1 firm for VC-backed IPOs. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of priced-round coverage across stages (Series A through late stage), named representative transactions, and independent corroboration of the practice's deal volume.
